title: Telecommunications (Amendment) Act 2005 (Act 10 of 2005)
header_as_printed: REPUBLIC OF SINGAPORE / GOVERNMENT GAZETTE / ACTS SUPPLEMENT / NO. 3 FRIDAY, FEBRUARY 18 2005 / First published in the Government Gazette, Electronic Edition, on 16th February 2005 at 5:00 pm. / passed by Parliament on 25th January 2005 and assented to by the President on 3rd February 2005 / No. 10 of 2005
source_provider: Republic of Singapore Government Gazette, e-Gazette (www.egazette.gov.sg); the PDF is served as a static file from assets.egazette.gov.sg
obtained_how: One GET request (python urllib, scratchpad tools/gazette-fetch.py), User-Agent "legalese-commons-source-fetcher/1.0 (+https://github.com/legalese/commons)", five seconds after the previous request, into a new download directory outside the repository. The assets host answered 200 with Content-Type application/pdf. The e-Gazette robots.txt disallows only /search on www.egazette.gov.sg; no search path was used.
terms: e-Gazette Terms of Use, https://www.egazette.gov.sg/terms-of-use/ (page said "Last updated on 10 July 2026" when read on 2026-11-03), clause 11 "Reproduction of legislation-Gazettes"; the wording is quoted in the licence note.
evidence_status: The e-Gazette FAQ (https://www.egazette.gov.sg/faq/, read 2026-11-03) says: "Before 9 March 2025, only copies of the Gazette printed by the Government Printer are regarded as prima facie evidence of their contents." This item was published before that date, so this copy is an aid and is not stated to be prima facie evidence.
pdftotext_version: none: the PDF has no text layer
ocr_how: pdftoppm -r 300 -png, then tesseract 5.5.3 -l eng --psm 4 on each of the 27 pages, the page texts joined with form feeds, unedited.
ocr_checked: Compared by eye with the page images (300 dpi renderings) on 2026-11-04 for four of the 27 pages only: page 1 (the Gazette heading: "First published in the Government Gazette, Electronic Edition, on 16th February 2005 at 5:00 pm", passed 25th January 2005, assented to 3rd February 2005, long title), page 2 (short title and commencement; amendment of s 2), page 21 (amendments of ss 64 and 65) and page 26 (amendment of s 72). On those four the wording, dates and figures matched the OCR text word for word; the OCR slips seen there are the list label "(6)" for "(b)" in section 2(b), and "(©)" for the circled "LS" seal beside the assent. The other 23 pages were not compared with their images and may contain misreadings; the PDF is the source.
